facts.fact: THD reports the national AI strategy has been in preparation since 2018 and that four ministers signed an MoU on preparing it and its implementation plan on 19 February 2022; as of 22 July 2026 the Official Gazette holds no text instituting or adopting it.

THD reports the steering structures meant to carry the strategy are idle or never created: the digital economy council has had no known meeting since 29 March 2018 and the digital development agency was never set up (article of 22 July 2026).
